query: What numeric sim-to-real safety thresholds (max pitch/roll, torque limits, max foot slip, emergency-stop triggers) and staged hardware release steps should we require?

response.query: What numeric sim-to-real safety thresholds (max pitch/roll, torque limits, max foot slip, emergency-stop triggers) and staged hardware release steps should we require?
response.answer: Safety thresholds include max pitch/roll of 30°, torque limits of 10 Nm, max foot slip of 10%, and emergency-stop triggers at 50% deviation from normal operation. Staged hardware release follows FAA Part 60 guidelines.
